We follow the standard practice and evaluate the performance of our models using the F1-measure at the top-K keyphrases (F1@K). Additionally, we apply stemming to both the extracted keyphrases and the gold truth. Our reported metrics include F1@5, F1@10, and F1@15 for our models and baselines on three benchmark datasets.
